About me I am currently a Research Fellow at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), under the supervision of Prof. CHEE Yeow Meng. I received my Ph.D. from the School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Southeast University, where I was advised by Prof. Bing Li. From 2024 to 2026, I was also a visiting Ph.D. student at the National University of Singapore, advised by Prof. Beng Chin Ooi, where I worked on efficient indexing in NeurDB.
Research My research focuses on machine learning and optimization techniques for data systems, including:
Self-designing learned indexes Secure learned indexes Privacy-preserving federated learning
